messages:
maria_marketing: Heads-up  T-12h to publish. Need a quick readout: final changelog anchor, docs deep-links, canary timing, webinar RSVP routing, and one-line benchmark blurb for the social post. Who has what?

emily_prod: I have the landing page live and the webinar CTAs wired. Page: https://redwood.ai/webinar/scale-ops. Primary CTA -> register, secondary -> docs. Also confirm we want the one-liner to call out "up to 2x lower cost at 99p"?

maria_marketing: Yes but softer: "up to 2x median token cost reduction in our benchmarks". Emily, make sure marketing gets a high-res chart for the post.

josh_eng: Changelog PR is queued: https://git.internal/redwood/changelog/pulls/5489. I added anchors: #what-changed, #migration-dedicated, #rollout-timing. Will merge when CI passes. Release tag will be v2.7.1-2026-03-19.

kira_docs: Docs anchors confirmed. Use /docs/serving/rollouts#pin-models for public, and /docs/dedicated/upgrade#rolling-upgrade for dedicated-tailored links. I've added a short snippet on pinning with example CLI:```redwoodctl pin --model v2.7.1```

maria_marketing: Good. Liam, are sales/AEs seeded with the top-50 list for outreach?

liam_sales: Got it. Sales ops has the list. We'll send a pre-release heads-up email as soon as canary hits 50% healthy. Routing: registrations tagged "product_interest: dedicated" -> AE queue `dedicated_inbound`.

sam_sre: Canary plan: start 07:00 PT tomorrow, 90m initial window, promote to 50% at +30m if metrics stable, full deploy at +90m. Will post metric snapshots to #live-metrics and set latency/err rate alerts. Auto-fallback rule ready if P99 > 800ms for 5m.

maria_marketing: We want to publish only after canary reaches 50% healthy. Emily will flip publish. Please double-check the webhook to Intercom so form tags flow.

emily_prod: Confirmed: forms -> webhook /webhooks/marketing/registrations -> Intercom. Rules: tag and create lead with custom attribute `interest`. I tested staging payloads.

josh_eng: One note: theres a known issue on specific kernels for long-seq workloads (tracked in changelog under "Known issues"). I added a short mitigation note and a link to `docs/serving/limits#long-requests`. Marketing can avoid technical callouts in the post, just link the full notes.

maria_marketing: OK we'll keep public copy lighter and link to changelog for details. Emily, draft social copy and I'll iterate. Include: headline, 2 bullets (perf + migration), 1 CTA (webinar) + secondary (docs).

kemia_docs: (typo correction) kira_docs: Also pushed small docs change to show step-by-step pin flow with screenshot at /assets/pin-flow.png.

maria_marketing: Nice. Josh, can you export the 50/99/median numbers for a tiny table? We want it under 3 rows.

josh_eng: Uploading CSV in 10m. Format: metric,baseline,new; will include units and testbed note.

liam_sales: Quick ask  can marketing include a one-click CTA in the webinar flow to request dedicated trials? If so, route to AE queue.

emily_prod: Yes  add checkbox on RSVP "Interested in Dedicated" -> will trigger `dedicated_inbound`. We'll surface that field in Intercom.

sam_sre: Reminder: schedule a post-canary status ping in this thread @ 07:35 PT (after 50% checkpoint) so we can proceed with publish.

maria_marketing: I'll be on watch. Deploy-bot, drop canary schedule here so we have a timestamp.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: release/v2.7.1 -> nodes at 2026-03-19T07:00:00-07:00. Notifications to #deploys and this channel.

maria_marketing: Any blockers now?

josh_eng: CI flake on one integration test, but unrelated to runtime. Will rerun and merge later this afternoon.

kira_docs: Docs change reviewed. No blockers.

emily_prod: Landing page analytics snippet added. We'll A/B test headline variants for CTR.

maria_marketing: Perfect  final checklist: changelog merged (josh), docs anchors + screenshot (kira), webinar page + webhook (emily), canary alerts + timeline (sam), sales list + AE routing (liam), post assets (marketing). Will call publish after Sam posts 50% healthy. :rocket:
